title.zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会通过稳定币兑换税及加密资产退出税修正案后否决预算收入部分
title.en: French lawmakers back stablecoin swap tax in 2027 budget bill

current_state.zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会已通过五项加密相关修正案（包括稳定币互换税、加密出境税和自托管钱包申报），随后否决了预算的收入部分；这些加密修正案需在议会辩论中重新提交才能成为法律。
current_state.en: France's National Assembly Finance Committee has adopted five crypto-related amendments (including a stablecoin swap tax, crypto exit tax, and self-custody wallet reporting), then rejected the budget's revenue section; the crypto amendments must be resubmitted during parliamentary debate to become law.

updates.title_zh: 法国议员支持在2027年预算法案中对稳定币兑换征税
updates.title_en: French lawmakers back stablecoin swap tax in 2027 budget bill
updates.what_changed_zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会批准了一项2027年预算法案修正案，将从2027年1月1日起把加密货币兑换为稳定币视为资本利得事件并征税，同时将针对未实现收益的退出税扩大至家庭持有量超过80万欧元并移居海外的加密投资者。
updates.what_changed_en: France's National Assembly Finance Committee approved an amendment to the 2027 budget bill that would tax crypto-to-stablecoin swaps as capital gains events starting January 1, 2027, and extend the exit tax on unrealized gains to crypto investors with household holdings above €800,000 relocating abroad.

updates.title_zh: 法国委员会支持稳定币兑换税和加密资产退出税，随后否决预算案
updates.title_en: French Committee Backs Stablecoin Swap Tax and Crypto Exit Tax, Then Rejects the Budget
updates.what_changed_zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会批准了对加密资产兑换为稳定币征税的修正案，并对富裕家庭征收加密资产退出税，随后否决了预算案的全部收入部分，将政府原始文本提交议会审议。
updates.what_changed_en: France's National Assembly Finance Committee approved amendments to tax crypto-to-stablecoin swaps and impose a crypto exit tax on wealthy households, then rejected the budget's entire revenue section, sending the government's original text to the floor.

updates.title_zh: 法国议员支持对超过11.2万美元的加密钱包实施申报规则
updates.title_en: French lawmakers back reporting rule for crypto wallets over $112K
updates.what_changed_zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会还通过了一项修正案（I-CF821），要求持有价值10万欧元及以上自托管加密资产的人每年申报持仓，未申报最高罚款1万欧元。
updates.what_changed_en: France's National Assembly Finance Committee also adopted an amendment (I-CF821) requiring holders of self-custodied crypto worth €100,000 or more to report holdings annually, with fines up to €10,000 for non-declaration.
updates.current_state_zh: 法国国民议会财政委员会已通过五项加密相关修正案（包括稳定币互换税、加密出境税和自托管钱包申报），随后否决了预算的收入部分；这些加密修正案需在议会辩论中重新提交才能成为法律。
updates.current_state_en: France's National Assembly Finance Committee has adopted five crypto-related amendments (including a stablecoin swap tax, crypto exit tax, and self-custody wallet reporting), then rejected the budget's revenue section; the crypto amendments must be resubmitted during parliamentary debate to become law.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: French lawmakers on the National Assembly's Finance Committee backed an amendment requiring holders of self-custodied crypto worth €100,000 or more to report those holdings annually, with fines up to €10,000 for non-declaration.
updates.detailed_summary_en: French lawmakers on the National Assembly's Finance Committee backed an amendment requiring holders of self-custodied crypto worth €100,000 or more to report those holdings annually, with fines up to €10,000 for non-declaration.
